summary: Azitra filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose the adjournment of its 2026 annual meeting due to a lack of quorum. No special-situation event occurred—the meeting was simply reconvened to June 15, 2026, with no changes to proposals or record date. The filing is a routine procedural update typical of shareholder meeting logistics, not a transformative corporate event. No deal terms, activist activity, or strategic review is involved. This filing is not classified as a special situation; it is a standard current report on meeting adjournment.
